title: Node SCHC ingress has no authenticated DIO bootstrap path
description: Correctness review found Node._process_received sends every non-fragment SCHC payload directly to LinkLayer.accept_authenticated_schc_packet(), which requires an already admitted authenticated peer SCHC context. Establishing that context requires accept_authenticated_dio()/accept_authenticated_schc_dio(), but Node never detects RPL DIO packets, owns/configures no DODAG admission context, and has no call path to either API (all current callers are tests or rpl/dodag.py used separately). A fresh Node therefore rejects the first valid DIO for lacking an existing peer policy and can never bootstrap ordinary SCHC data acceptance. Integrate authenticated DIO dispatch/admission into the Node/RPL receive path with configured instance/DODAG/MOP/role, then route ordinary data only after the admitted context; add cold-start tests from first signed DIO through subsequent SCHC data.
notes: Implemented optional all-or-none NodeConfig authenticated RPL admission scope, Node-owned DodagState wired into Router, structural non-consuming DIO classification, existing atomic authenticated DODAG/SCHC policy admission, and cold-start DIO-to-ordinary-data integration regression. Focused combined gate: 281 passed; Ruff, node mypy, diff check clean.
